[P2] Describe the actual checkpoint-thread hook execution

`ExecutionState.checkpoint_batches_forever()` synchronously calls `PluginExecutor.on_operation_update()`, which dispatches `on_operation_end` and `on_operation_change` before signaling checkpoint waiters. A slow hook therefore blocks checkpoints for waiting branches of that invocation; `on_operation_change` has no separate dispatcher thread. Plugins following the stated thread-affinity guarantees can also access the wrong thread-local context. Document the existing execution and blocking semantics, or include the dispatcher changes needed to establish these guarantees.
